chromosomes.description: Chromosome allow-list; default from project chromosomes.
chromosomes.title: Chromosomes

context.description: Haplotype context. Only CG is supported.
context.title: Context

control_bed.description: Optional BED of panel positive/negative controls to drop from discovery.
control_bed.title: Control Bed

core_window.description: Seed window size in CpGs (Guo/mHap uses 3). Operator-set.
core_window.title: Core Window

mhb_bed.description: Frozen MHB BED (chrom start end [name]). Required for locked mode.
mhb_bed.title: Mhb Bed

mhl_max_length.description: Maximum consecutive-haplotype length for MHL (Wong uses 10). Operator-set.
mhl_max_length.title: Mhl Max Length

min_cpgs.description: Minimum CpGs per retained block. Operator-set.
min_cpgs.title: Min Cpgs

min_median_reads.description: Minimum median overlapping reads per block. Operator-set.
min_median_reads.title: Min Median Reads

mode.description: discovery: Guo/mHap-style LD blocks. locked: operator mhb_bed, skip LD. Operator-set per procedure/profile.
mode.title: Mode

p_max.description: Maximum p-value for adjacent-CpG correlation. Operator-set.
p_max.title: P Max

r2_min.description: Minimum adjacent-CpG Pearson r² for block extension. Operator-set.
r2_min.title: R2 Min

sample_id_column.description: Column name for sample identifier in mhl_matrix.csv.
sample_id_column.title: Sample Id Column
